# Getting help with QuickAI

- **How do I…?** Press **F1** in QuickAI for Help, with pictures of the window, a button that shows where each thing
  is, and a short tour. The [README](../README.md) and the [docs](../docs/README.md) have the rest.
- **Questions, ideas and setups to share:** [Discussions](https://github.com/everybodyai/quickai/discussions).
- **Something doesn't work:** **Help → Report a problem** in QuickAI opens a bug report filled in for you, with your
  folders, names and addresses taken out, or open one [here](https://github.com/everybodyai/quickai/issues/new/choose).
- **Security problems:** privately, as [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) describes.
- **Organizations** rolling QuickAI out can get paid help with deployment and support:
  [everybodyai.dev/organizations](https://everybodyai.dev/organizations).
